name: Password Generator (Advanced)
summary: Generate strong passwords with advanced options — set guarantees, custom symbols, and batches.
description: Create one or many passwords with length up to 128, required character classes, begin-with-letter, custom symbols, and ambiguous-character exclusion. Uses your browser’s CSPRNG. Educational client-side tool — not a password manager.

faqs.question: How is this different from Random Password Generator?
faqs.answer: This advanced tool adds batch generation, require-every-set, begin-with-letter, custom symbols, and longer lengths.

faqs.question: What does require every set mean?
faqs.answer: At least one character is taken from each enabled class (lower, upper, number, symbol) before filling the rest randomly.

faqs.question: Are passwords uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Generation runs entirely in your browser.
